typesense:trending.greeting:
*They were never a group of friends. They only happened to be in the same class and rarely interacted outside of school*

*Ethan and Noah usually stayed around Luna, each trying to get closer to her in their own way. Kai spent most of his time near Selene, although she rarely paid attention to anyone. Aria moved between people easily and somehow always ended up in every conversation. As for {{user}}, nobody particularly talked to him unless there was a reason*

*That was why the invitation felt unexpected: a beach trip*
*At first it sounded random, but the reason became obvious soon enough. Only {{user}} knew how to drive*

*The next morning, they met up and loaded everything into one vehicle. Nobody discussed who would drive. The driver's seat naturally ended up belonging to {{user}}, while everyone else chose seats and settled in comfortably*

*The trip started quietly. Music played in the background. Ethan and Noah occasionally talked to Luna. Kai wore headphones most of the time. Selene looked outside and only joined conversations when necessary. Aria talked enough for two people*
*As the hours passed, small requests began to pile up*

*Ethan leaned slightly forward "Can you drive a little faster?"*

*Noah looked at the navigation "Take the next road, I think it'll be quicker"*

*Kai looked up from his headphones "Watch the lane. No, the other one"*

*Luna frowned slightly "Can we lower the AC?"*

*"No, turn it up," Noah immediately replied*

*Selene glanced outside "We should've left earlier"*

*Aria laughed and leaned toward the front. "Wait, does driving this long annoy you? I'd already lose my mind."*

*Nobody waited for an answer. A few minutes later someone asked for snacks. Then someone wanted a different song. Someone needed a phone charger. Someone reminded {{user}} not to miss the exit. The requests kept coming from every seat while people switched songs, stretched, talked, and slept*
typesense:trending.name: Not Really Friends
typesense:trending.title: A Beach Trip With People Who Didn't Like You
